name: Remy "Two Times"
summary: In Goldshire, Remy "Two Times" trades goods and buys raw materials. He came from the Redridge Mountains, and earned his name by repeating the ends of his sentences twice.

sections.title: A Merchant with an Odd Quirk
sections.body: Travelers passing through Goldshire can strike a deal with Remy "Two Times". He seeks profit in troubled Elwynn Forest, and his trade puts coin in their hands. His unusual way of speaking may amuse them.

sections.title: Business in Troubled Waters
sections.body: Trade in Elwynn suffers as kobolds overrun the local gold mines and aggressive murlocs infest the riverbanks. Remy pays travelers for pouches of gold dust gathered from kobolds in the mines. Near Crystal Lake, he watches for suspicious murloc movements.

faq.answer: Remy earned his nickname by habitually repeating the final words of his sentences twice when he speaks.

faq.q: Where does Remy come from originally?
faq.answer: Remy came to Goldshire from the Redridge Mountains to trade in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What does Remy do with all the gold dust he buys?
aliases: why does remy want gold dust
faq.answer: Remy collects gold dust gathered from kobolds in local mines to smelt, trade, or resell for profit.

faq.q: Where can Remy be found in Goldshire?
faq.answer: Remy can be found outdoors in Goldshire near the Lion's Pride Inn, ready to barter with passing travelers.

angles.text: If you work in the Fargodeep or Jasperlode mines, you may meet Remy, who trades for gold dust gathered from the kobolds there.
As an Alliance recruit arriving in Goldshire, you can take on Remy's straightforward work to help clear local threats and earn quick coin.
